ERR-021.title: G-C04: logging.rs had no CMMI-L5 traceable fields
ERR-021.error_message: Log lines carried only target/level/message; missing timestamp, function_id, span_id, trace_id, category, duration_us, file, line
ERR-021.root_cause: Original init() set up a minimal EnvFilter + fmt layer with .compact() formatting; no span events, no RFC-3339 timer, no thread ids, no file/line.
ERR-021.resolution: Replaced init() with CMMI-L5 version: SystemTime RFC-3339 timer, with_target(true), with_thread_ids(true), with_file(true), with_line_number(true), with_span_events(FmtSpan::ENTER | FmtSpan::CLOSE), with_current_span(true). Default verbosity warn -> info. Added flush() helper.
ERR-021.lessons: CMMI Level 5 institutionalization is operationalised through structured logging fields, not through after-the-fact documentation. Every #[instrument] attribute should carry fields(category, function_id).

ERR-022.title: G-L11: GenError variants carried no stable error_code
ERR-022.error_message: GenError taxonomy had 11 variants but no stable identifier per variant; CI tooling could not aggregate defect rates by code without parsing free-form messages
ERR-022.root_cause: Original GenError only exposed is_db_error() and the Display impl. No machine-readable code per variant.
ERR-022.resolution: Added GenError::error_code() returning GEN-001..GEN-011 (GEN-099 for Other). Added GenError::cmmi_pa() returning owning Process Area. main.rs logs both fields on every terminal error.
ERR-022.lessons: The error_code is the join key between runtime log lines, error_inventory.json entries, and CI errors stats aggregation. Treat it as a public API: never renumber existing codes, only append.

ERR-023.title: G-H03: ERROR_INVENTORY.md was Markdown-only, not machine-readable
ERR-023.error_message: ERROR_INVENTORY.md was hand-edited Markdown; no JSON schema, no append-only writer API, no list/add/resolve/stats CLI
ERR-023.root_cause: Original inventory had no schema; defect edits required manually editing Markdown tables.
ERR-023.resolution: Added src/error_inventory.rs exporting Inventory + ErrorEntry + Status + Severity serde structs with versioned schema_version. API: load, add (append-only), resolve, next_id, write_json, write_markdown, render_markdown. Every mutation is #[instrument]-ed with category = error_inventory. Wired hex-gen errors {list,add,resolve,stats} CLI subcommand. Markdown view regenerated from JSON on every mutation.
ERR-023.lessons: Markdown is for humans; JSON is for tooling. When both must coexist, generate the Markdown from the JSON - never edit the Markdown directly. The 5 unit tests in error_inventory::tests cover the round-trip and the append-only invariant.

ERR-024.title: G-L12: process::exit(1) before tracing flush on Windows
ERR-024.error_message: When the generator hit a terminal GenError, main() called tracing::error!(...) and then immediately std::process::exit(1). On Windows, the buffered tracing layer can drop the final log record before it drains.
ERR-024.root_cause: No explicit flush hook between the final error! and process::exit.
ERR-024.resolution: Added logging::flush() (a documented best-effort drain hook that will become a real OTLP flush when Enhancement 5 lands the OTLP exporter). Called from both the normal main() error path and the run_errors_cmd() path. Also added error_code and cmmi_pa to the final error! log line.
ERR-024.lessons: Always flush before process::exit. The flush() function is intentionally a no-op today so the call site does not need to change when the OTLP exporter lands - the hook is already in place.

ERR-025.title: G-C01: OpenAPI 3.1 - utoipa 5 emits 3.0.3 only
ERR-025.error_message: utoipa 5 emits OpenAPI 3.0.3 natively; there is no stable openapi_3_1 feature flag in any released utoipa 5 version. OpenAPI 3.1 is a breaking spec change (JSON Schema 2020-12, native webhooks, type:[X,null] nullable representation).
ERR-025.root_cause: The enhancement report assumed utoipa 5 had an openapi_3_1 feature flag; in fact the flag is only in the unreleased utoipa 6 alpha. The first regeneration failed at cargo check time.
ERR-025.resolution: Dropped the (non-existent) openapi_3_1 feature flag. Kept the standard utoipa 5 #[derive(OpenApi)] for 3.0.3. Added a to_3_1() post-processor in the generated api/openapi.rs that upgrades the utoipa JSON at serve-time: sets openapi:3.1.0, adds jsonSchemaDialect, injects native 3.1 webhooks for every audit-log table, recursively converts every nullable:true schema into the 3.1-native type:[X,null] union.
ERR-025.lessons: When a library's documentation suggests a feature exists, verify with cargo check before committing the generated Cargo.toml. The post-processor pattern is the safe path when the library cannot natively emit the target spec.

ERR-026.title: G-C02: No GraphQL SDL or resolver generation
ERR-026.location: src/codegen/graphql.rs (new, 350 LOC), src/codegen/mod.rs, src/codegen/wiring.rs, src/codegen/project_files.rs, src/codegen/domain.rs, src/codegen/assets.rs
ERR-026.error_message: The generator emitted only a REST surface; DEF-04 in the v0.2 inventory tracked GraphQL as deferred scope.
ERR-026.resolution: Added src/codegen/graphql.rs emitting a src/graphql/ directory into every generated project: schema.graphql (SDL with types, native PG enums, FK relation fields, Federation @key directives on audit-log tables), mod.rs (manifest + build_schema() + SCHEMA_STR include_str! constant), root.rs (QueryRoot + MutationRoot with noop ping() so async-graphql's at-least-one-field rule is satisfied), resolvers/<table>.rs delegating to existing ServicePort traits, dataloader.rs and federation.rs skeletons for v0.4.0. Entity types now derive async_graphql::SimpleObject; native PG enums derive async_graphql::Enum with rename_items=snake_case. Generated Cargo.toml gains async-graphql=7 with chrono/uuid/decimal/tracing features plus async-graphql-axum=7.
ERR-026.lessons: async-graphql's Object type must define one or more fields rule is a hard compile error on empty #[Object] impls. Always include a noop field (we use ping() -> true) on root types. The decimal feature on async-graphql is essential for any project that introspects numeric columns.

ERR-027.title: G-C03: Single DATABASE_URL only - no multi-tenant support
ERR-027.location: src/connection_profile.rs (new), src/introspect.rs, src/codegen/pool_registry.rs (new), src/codegen/assets.rs, src/codegen/infrastructure.rs, src/main.rs, Cargo.toml
ERR-027.error_message: The generator accepted a single DATABASE_URL and a single schema. There was no way to target N databases, no SSL mode flag, no SSH tunnel, no per-tenant SET ROLE.
ERR-027.root_cause: No connection-profile schema existed; the Config struct held one URL.
ERR-027.resolution: Added src/connection_profile.rs with serde structs ConnectionProfile, SslModeCfg, SshTunnel, PoolCfg, and ProfileSet::parse_toml(). Added introspect::introspect_profile() that connects via profile URL, optionally SET ROLEs to the profile's introspect_role (with validate_pg_identifier defense-in-depth guard), runs catalog queries, RESET ROLE before closing. Added --profiles <path> CLI flag. Added src/codegen/pool_registry.rs emitting src/infrastructure/db/pool_registry.rs into every generated project - PoolRegistry keyed by profile id + ScopedConn guard that emits SET app.current_tenant=$1 on acquire and RESET on Drop. Extended generated config/settings.rs and config/mod.rs with the ConnectionProfile family. Cargo.toml gains toml=0.8.
ERR-027.lessons: Always validate Postgres identifiers before interpolating them into SET ROLE SQL - even when the source is a config file rather than user input - because a misconfigured role name can become a SQL injection vector if the profile is later sourced from an untrusted location.

ERR-028.title: G-C04 generated side: LOGGING_* asset had no CMMI-L5 fields
ERR-028.location: src/codegen/assets.rs:LOGGING_INIT constant (the template that becomes src/logging/init.rs in every generated project)
ERR-028.error_message: ERR-021 fixed the generator's own logging::init() to emit CMMI-L5 fields. The generated project's logging::init() (a separate constant in codegen/assets.rs) was unchanged - it still used the minimal EnvFilter + fmt::layer().with_target(true) setup from v0.2.
ERR-028.root_cause: Two copies of the logging init: one for the generator (src/logging.rs) and one for the generated project (codegen/assets.rs::LOGGING_INIT). The v0.2.1 batch only patched the first.
ERR-028.resolution: Replaced LOGGING_INIT with a CMMI-L5 version: SystemTime RFC-3339 timer, with_target(true) for function_id, with_thread_ids(true), with_file(true), with_line_number(true), with_span_events(FmtSpan::ENTER | FmtSpan::CLOSE) for duration_us, with_current_span(true) for span_id/trace_id. OTLP export gated behind OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Updated LOGGING_MOD to re-export flush_logging. Added flush() helper mirroring the generator-side one.
ERR-028.lessons: When a fix exists in two places (the generator's own code AND the generated code's template), patch both in the same batch. The v0.2.1 batch only patched the generator side; v0.3.0 closes the loop.
